verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares says board approvals are built into every relevant workflow, and that award agreements are tied to the corresponding board consent. Grants appear to default to FMV pricing, with an explicit opt-in to price above or below it. Promises in Gusto offer letters can be turned into grants automatically. 409A valuations come from third-party providers and only on the Growth plan. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing the 409A value auto-populating the strike price inside the grant workflow, a step-by-step option-grant walkthrough, 409A availability on lower plan tiers, and independent hands-on corroboration.
